decisions.reason: As a yogurt variant very close to the firm's cultured-dairy capabilities and already externally validated, it is the kind of product the firm can continue to refine and exploit with little new knowledge risk.
This flagship cheese extension remains tightly aligned with the firm's core cheese know-how and strategic direction, so management would be inclined to retain it unless demand clearly weakened.
The semi-hard cheese wheel fits existing production and market knowledge well, but its lower visibility and less distinctive positioning make it somewhat more exposed to later portfolio pruning.
A spicy cheese line with several models gives the firm a familiar platform for learning from customer feedback and adjusting variants, which supports continuation rather than withdrawal.

The mild creamy soft cheese builds on established cheese expertise and should be improvable through routine product learning, though some overlap with the broader cheese range raises a moderate rationalization risk.
